instructions_to_main_agent: Always place data-testid attributes on interactive components (buttons, tabs, form inputs, modals).
Ensure bottom navigation bar is fixed on mobile viewports (<640px) and hides smoothly on desktop, where a left sidebar handles navigation.
Implement the 6 post categories with distinct color-coded badges and filtering capability.
Ensure the 'Utile' button increments/decrements contribution score transparently without vanity metrics.
Provide modal for report content (Signalement) with selectable reasons (Spam, Contenu inapproprié, Démarchage commercial, Harcèlement).
Strictly follow high contrast guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AA) and minimum 44px touch targets for mobile accessibility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark gradients globally; keep backgrounds clean and earthy.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid for automated testing.
Respect system prefers-reduced-motion for smooth transitions.
Use sonner for user feedback and toast notifications.
